title.rendered: FTS Mod FIFA 18 Ultimate By Iqbal Apk + Obb Data

content.rendered:
Download FTS Mod FIFA 18 Ultimate By Iqbal. This is a First Touch Soccer  game for android phone and it is also a mod version. It is important to get FTS Mod FIFA 18 Ultimate By Iqbal Apk + Obb Data, because the list of players have been updated, with many features mentioned in this article.  The file is just 353.5 MB in size, which runs without any problem on your Android device and is easy to install.

FTS Mod FIFA 18 Ultimate By Iqbal Apk + Obb Data

Name: FTS Mod FIFA 18 Ultimate By Iqbal

Size: 353.5 MB

Features

  1. New UCL 18 and PL 18

  3. New supporters banner
  4. New industrial
  5. New HD neutral stage
  6. New training ground environment
  7. New goals

  11. New HD player skin: Messi, Ronaldo, Neymar, Douglas Costa, Martial, Reus, Rooney, Marcelo, Pogba, Aubameyang, Mario Balotelli etc.
  12. New trainingbib

How To Install FTS Mod FIFA 18 Ultimate By Iqbal Apk + Obb On Android Device

Follow the simple steps listed below to install the game on your Android phone:

1. After you download the apk and obb data extract it using >> Zarchive apk

2. Open Zarchive or any similar file used in extracting zip, rar files, locate the obb files and long press on one of them, a option box will pop up then mark the three obb data and extract them into Android/obb folder.

3. Finally Install the Apk and open the game to start playing.
